_comment: Demo mailbox of Alex Rivera. Person keys come from people.json. Dates are before the capture clock (2026-03-10 09:30 UTC, a Tuesday). 'reply' names the message this one answers (threads on stack E). '@id' in a header value becomes that message's Message-ID.

messages.subject: Spring catalogue: print proof
messages.text:
Hi Sam,

The final files for the spring catalogue are in the shared folder. Could you send a printed proof of pages 1 to 8 before we approve the run?

Thanks,
Alex

messages.subject: Re: Spring catalogue: print proof
messages.text:
Hi Alex,

The proof is attached. The blue on page 3 prints slightly darker than on screen; tell me if you want us to adjust it.

Sam

messages.subject: Re: Spring catalogue: print proof
messages.text:
Thanks Sam. Priya will check the colour on page 3 tomorrow morning and reply to you directly.

Alex

messages.subject: Re: Spring catalogue: print proof
messages.text:

Page 3 looks right on the printed proof. Please go ahead with the run of 2,000 copies.
